summary.result: The results indicate that the suspended sediment causes increasing spectral reflectance response in waters.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to investigate the basic relationships between spectral reflectance and varying concentrations of sediment in surface waters.
summary.method: An experimental method for determining suspended sediment concentration (SSC) in the water by use of a spectroradiometer above the water surface, in visible and near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths, is applied.
